top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Use of Cryptographically Weak Pseudo-Random Number Generator (PRNG)
top_sast_rules.description: Using a cryptographically weak pseudo-random number generator to generate a security-sensitive value may allow an attacker to predict what value will be generated.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Use cryptographically secure random number generators (SecureRandom, os.urandom, crypto.getRandomValues) instead of predictable PRNGs.

top_sast_rules.description: Using cookies without CSRF protection may allow malicious websites to submit requests on behalf of the user.
